text:
marta: Quick sync on the client-surface rollout for API/SDK v21. Deploy window planned TOMORROW at 09:00 PT. Need: who owns canary buckets, smoke checklist, rollback target, and a short client comms blurb. I'll coordinate release notes.
kevin: I can own the canary and smoke runs. Plan: start with 5% in us-west-2 for 15m, then 25% for 20m, then full. Will run the smoke script and spot-check telemetry.
kevin: Smoke steps (I'll run these, call out if someone else wants to double-check):
```
# health
curl -sS https://api-us-west2.redwood.cloud/v21/health
# simple generate
curl -X POST https://api-us-west2.redwood.cloud/v21/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize: Redwood rollout"}' | jq .
# embeddings quick check
curl -X POST https://api-us-west2.redwood.cloud/v21/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq .
```
kevin: I'll also validate latency p95 and error-rate <0.5% during each step.
aisha: I'll draft the client comms (short blurb + migration notes). Quick ask: any behavior changes or breaking client API surfaces in v21 I should highlight?
marta: No breaking changes to the public method names, but there is a change in default tokenization that can affect token counts for a small subset of prompts. Recommend calling out the token budgeting note in the email.
lina: I'll update the compatibility matrix and add a short migration snippet to docs (link to be posted here once ready).
kevin: For rollout flags: we'll flip feature flag `sdk_v21_enabled` at the gateway. Canary config stored in /deploy/canaries/v21.json. Example entry:
```
{"region":"us-west-2","buckets":[{"name":"canary-a","pct":5},{"name":"canary-b","pct":25}]}
```
tom: Oncall here. I'll be on standby during deploy window 08:45–10:30 PT. If canary error-rate >1% or latency p95 regresses >40% vs baseline, escalate and we'll pause.
tom: Rollback plan: if we need to revert, we tag gateway back to v20 image and revert the feature flag. Command from runbook:
```
# revert gateway deployment
kubectl -n redwood set image deploy/gateway gateway=redwood/gateway:v20.18.3
# unflip flag
redwoodctl feature toggle sdk_v21_enabled false
```
kevin: I'll have a canary-only watch dashboard and a short health check playbook pinned in the canary room.
aisha: Comms blurb (draft): "Tomorrow 09:00 PT we will roll out SDK v21 with backward-compatible changes. Primary impact: slightly different token accounting for some prompts — see migration guide. No client code changes required, opt-in recommended for full testing." Thoughts?
marta: looks good. Add a link to the migration guide and note how to opt into v21 prior to full rollout (flag or header). kevin: will add the header opt-in docs.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rbw-2245-v21, window=2026-03-18T16:00Z (09:00 PT). Responsible=kevin.
kevin: small ask: can someone on SDK bindings (js/python) sanity-check client examples the docs call out? @lina can you ping SDK owners?
lina: pinged @sdk-team (threaded) and asked for a quick check by EOD today. I'll post confirmations here.
marta: ownership summary: canary & smoke = kevin; oncall = tom; docs/migration = lina; client comms = aisha; release notes + overall coord = marta. Everyone ack here and I'll open the release checklist.
kevin: ack. I'll paste smoke run logs in the canary room and tag this thread when each phase completes.
aisha: ack, will send client advisory 1h before full rollout and post release notes after successful full rollout.
tom: ack, I'll escalate if we hit thresholds. Also adding an incident stub now to speed response if needed.
marta: Thanks — one last thing: please capture any observed client regressions in #support and tag the SDK owners. I'll close the checklist when the post-rollout verification is green. :thumbsup:
